en.t: A corpse can only be looked at by others.

units.source_text: 所谓看，正如平时无任何意识的动作；

en.t: This thing called looking is just like an action we normally perform without any awareness;

units.source_text: 所谓看，是生存者的权利的证明，也可能是残酷性的表示。

en.t: This thing called looking is proof of the rights of the living, and it may also be an expression of cruelty.

units.source_text: 对我来说，这是一种新鲜的体验。

en.t: For me, this was a fresh experience.

units.source_text: 一个既没有大声歌唱，也不叫唤着四处奔跑的少年，就这样学到了确认自己的生。

en.t: In this way, a boy who neither sang loudly nor ran about shouting learned to confirm his own life.
